question: The graphs of the equations 3x - 2y -11 = 0 and x + y = 7 intersect at P (α, β). What is the value of (3α + 5β)?
solution:
**Given:**

Equation (1) = 3x - 2y - 11 = 0

Equation (2) = x + y = 7

Intersect point = P(α, β)

**Concept used:**

We will solve the linear equations.

The value of x and y will be the coordinates of intersecting point P.

**Calculation:**

3x - 2y = 11 ------(i)

x + y = 7 ------(ii)

Multiplying eq (ii) by 3, we get,

3x + 3y = 21 ----(iii)

By solving equation (i) and (ii) we get

5y = 10

⇒ y = 2

Now putting the value of y in eq (ii) we get,

x = 5,

P (α, β) = P (5, 2)

So, α = 5, β = 2 

Now,

(3α + 5β)

⇒ 3 × 5 + 5 × 2

⇒ 15 + 10

⇒ 25

**∴ The value of (3α + 5β) is 25.**
